name: Native streaming dictation over WebSocket
sources: cpp/serve/main.cpp:942-1091 (WS handler: controls, audio frames, error frames, heartbeat)

cases.name: reset discards buffered audio
cases.note: reset also re-enables audio acceptance after a buffer-cap error or an invalid-audio rejection.

cases.name: commit with an empty buffer yields an empty final
audio then commit yields partials and a final
cases.note: First partial needs at least 5 s of audio (--min-chunk-seconds) and partials are at least 3 s apart (--partial-interval-seconds). WAV frames are equally accepted; a partial may or may not precede the commit depending on timing.

cases.name: busy commit retains the audio
cases.note: Bounded busy retries on flush; the audio is retained, so a repeated commit retries it rather than emitting an empty final. Observed on the placeholder-model test server; a loaded model returns the final instead.

cases.name: live buffer cap rejects a frame once

audio.note: would push the live buffer past the 60 s default cap

ws_messages.message: stream buffer limit reached (60 s live buffer); audio ignored until reset

cases.note: The number in the message is the configured cap (--max-stream-seconds; 60 s default, 0 = unlimited). The cap bounds the live un-finalized buffer only; finalized windows are trimmed. Control frames keep working; reset re-enables audio.

cases.name: malformed WAV frame invalidates the take

ws_frames.note: RIFF/WAVE magic truncated before the fmt chunk

ws_messages.message: malformed WAV frame rejected; audio ignored until reset

cases.name: non-16kHz WAV frame invalidates the take

ws_messages.message: WAV sample rate mismatch: expected 16000; audio ignored until reset

cases.name: odd-length PCM frame invalidates the take

audio.note: with one extra trailing byte (split sample)

ws_messages.message: odd-length PCM frame rejected (split sample); audio ignored until reset

cases.note: Frames are sequences of whole int16 samples; re-send on whole-sample boundaries.

cases.name: commit on an invalidated take is refused

ws_messages.message: WAV sample rate mismatch: expected 16000; audio ignored until reset

cases.note: Never a successful final over an incomplete capture; the client falls back to its authoritative local recording. Reason codes: malformed_wav, sample_rate_mismatch, odd_pcm_length.

response.after_disconnect: The server tears the session down without sending frames (a stderr log line only); buffered audio is discarded. Server-side heartbeat pings every 30 s and closes after 3 missed pongs detect dead connections.
